package.description: Optimized I2P JSON-RPC SAM-bridged messenger with post-quantum encryption.

en-US.description: Optimized I2P JSON-RPC SAM-bridged messenger with post-quantum encryption.
en-US.longDescription: A decentralized messenger for the I2P network. Unlike other versions, this one is optimized for low memory usage and supports Windows XP (x86). Supports JSON-RPC on /swagger-ui page.  To use the web-interface, create a 'server' directory and download index.html: mkdir server && curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wipedlifepotato/Kekulen-I2P-Messanger/SAM/server/index.html -o server/index.html
en-US.name: Kekulen I2P Chat (Fix Edition)
